implementation: Owned PreparedSchema with cached artifact identity and owned Cow fragments; no unsafe self-reference.
Strict one-frame checksummed zstd over unchanged SCVAL001, with target-specific intermediate bound before allocation.
Separate prepared compression/decompression contexts; trained dictionaries copied once per context.
Existing dictionary encoding remains available and matches reused-context output on tested alternating/repeated inputs.
Context sizeof drift guard drops an oversized context fail-closed; this is not a custom allocator or RSS cap.
accounting: retained_bytes reports owned payload bytes and zstd sizeof where applicable, excluding Rust/allocator bookkeeping; retained_charge is conservative admission accounting. Construction and temporary buffers are separate.
